problem: Three successive Flash mechanisms failed to generate corpus-grounded bridge vocabulary on saved retrieval misses, even when draft context, candidate selection, and seed retention were varied independently. Before adding orchestration, the project must determine whether the frozen generator choice is below the task's bridge-inference requirement.
simplest_baseline: Reuse the exact registered Hypothesis Firewall prompt, context fields, parser, three-query search slate, retriever, cases, and acceptance gates. Change only deepseek-v4-flash to deepseek-v4-pro with thinking still disabled.
hypothesis: Under identical non-thinking inputs and retrieval execution, deepseek-v4-pro will generate bridge anchors that retrieve gold on at least two of the three saved failures. A failure means model substitution alone is insufficient; a pass only selects a viable generator for later fixed-topology experiments.
changed_mechanisms: bridge generator substitution from deepseek-v4-flash to deepseek-v4-pro
anti_claim: This is a model-selection capability diagnostic, not a harness improvement. Any difference must be attributed to the generator substitution until a later comparison locks the same model topology on both arms.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: A configurable model layer is useful only after the generator meets the task floor. This gate tests that floor without adopting DeerFlow's broader sub-agent runtime.
Its configurable model boundary supports separating model choice from orchestration. This diagnostic changes the model only and makes no architecture claim.

relevant_mechanisms: configurable smart and fast LLM roles
framework_comparisons.current_gap: Model routing is common and therefore not the project's novelty. A later experiment must compare both harness arms under the same fixed routing and budget.
A stronger planner may improve graph quality, but this gate keeps the graph fixed at three searches so model capability is not confused with graph expansion.

frozen_controls: same three saved open-debt development cases
same Hypothesis Firewall prompt builder and Pydantic schema
same question, obligation, and unverified-subject context fields
thinking disabled on both Flash and Pro
one provider attempt and exactly three top-20 searches per case
same query-aware BM25-anchor plus Dense-lead retriever
official DeepSeek USD rates captured in the tracked provider config
no Writer or Judge during capability calibration
next_action: Do not adopt model substitution as the fix. Open a retrieval-first clue-frontier loop that obtains corpus-grounded near-miss evidence from independently searchable clue groups before asking any model to synthesize bridge entities.
claim_boundary: This loop can select a generator for future experiments only. It cannot support a harness-effect, end-to-end, official accuracy, unseen generalization, leaderboard, training, or model-capability-improvement claim.
